nodes.label: Post-Build click.mp3 Copy
nodes.rationale: click.mp3 is copied next to the built executable as a runtime fallback for the click sound.

nodes.label: RC-Embedded App Manifest
nodes.rationale: app.manifest is embedded by ClipboardManager.rc (RT_MANIFEST) so it works under both MSVC and MinGW. MSVC's linker would otherwise generate a competing manifest, so /MANIFEST:NO is used and the resource step re-runs whenever the manifest changes.

nodes.label: Media Foundation Click Sound Decode
nodes.rationale: Media Foundation (mfplat, mf, mfreadwrite, mfuuid) decodes MP3 to WAV for a reliable click sound.

nodes.label: Optional UIAutomation Link
nodes.rationale: UIAutomationCore is searched in the Windows SDK so Copy from focused control works when an app never puts content on the clipboard. If the library is missing, that feature is disabled.

nodes.label: Debounced Atomic History Save
nodes.rationale: Saves are debounced about 1.5 s after the last change, written atomically (history.dat.tmp then rename), and flushed on exit. Unreferenced blob files are removed after a successful save.

nodes.label: DPAPI Per-User Encryption
nodes.rationale: The CLP3 outer container is DPAPI-encrypted per Windows user. Legacy plaintext CLP2 loads and upgrades on the next save.

nodes.label: History Capture Limits
nodes.rationale: Runtime capture allows up to 12 formats per item, under 5 MB per format and 10 MB total per item, so history stays bounded.

nodes.label: Per-Item Trigram Index
nodes.rationale: A per-item trigram index keeps large histories responsive while fuzzy matching (subsequence + ranking) over up to 500 KB of text per item.
